title: Block coordinate index
statement: For each integer $m \ge 7$, block index $b \in \{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and position $j \in \{0,\ldots,2m-1\}$, let $c(m,b,j)$ be the block-coordinate value associated with these indices. The block coordinate is the index $c(m,b,j)$ in $\{0,\ldots,2^m-1\}$.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definition of the block-coordinate value, so its assignment cannot be described more explicitly.
